abbrev Checked (α : Type) := Except RSFError α

def checkedMul (a b : Nat) (bound : Nat := 2^64 - 1) : Checked Nat :=
  if h : a * b ≤ bound then .ok (a * b) else .error .Overflow

def checkedMulU64 (a b : Nat) : Checked Nat := checkedMul a b (2^64 - 1)

def checkedAddU64 (a b : Nat) : Checked Nat :=
  if h : a + b ≤ 2^64 - 1 then .ok (a + b) else .error .Overflow

theorem checkedMul_ok_val {a b bound n : Nat}
    (h : checkedMul a b bound = .ok n) : n = a * b := by
  simp only [checkedMul] at h
  split at h
  · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
    exact h.symm
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h

theorem checkedMul_ok_le {a b bound n : Nat}
    (h : checkedMul a b bound = .ok n) : n ≤ bound := by
  simp only [checkedMul] at h
  split at h
  case isTrue ht =>
    simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact ht
  case isFalse =>
    simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h

theorem checkedAddU64_ok_val {a b n : Nat}
    (h : checkedAddU64 a b = .ok n) : n = a + b := by
  simp only [checkedAddU64] at h
  split at h
  · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
    exact h.symm
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h

theorem checkedMulU64_ok_val {a b n : Nat}
    (h : checkedMulU64 a b = .ok n) : n = a * b := by
  exact checkedMul_ok_val h

theorem checkedMul_comm (a b bound : Nat) :

  simp only [checkedMul, Nat.mul_comm]

structure HeapCell where
  value : ℝ
  allocated : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Heap where
  cells : List HeapCell
  deriving DecidableEq

def Heap.empty : Heap := { cells := [] }

def Heap.alloc (h : Heap) (size : Nat) (initVal : ℝ) : Heap × Nat :=
  let startIdx := h.cells.length
  let newCells := List.replicate size { value := initVal, allocated := true }
  ({ cells := h.cells ++ newCells }, startIdx)

def Heap.free (h : Heap) (startIdx : Nat) (size : Nat) : Heap :=
  { cells := h.cells.mapIdx fun i cell =>
      if startIdx ≤ i ∧ i < startIdx + size then
        { cell with allocated := false }
      else cell }

def Heap.read (h : Heap) (idx : Nat) : Checked ℝ :=
  if hidx : idx < h.cells.length then
    let cell := h.cells.get ⟨idx, hidx⟩
    if cell.allocated then .ok cell.value
    else .error .UseAfterFree
  else .error .DataLengthMismatch

def Heap.write (h : Heap) (idx : Nat) (val : ℝ) : Checked Heap :=
  if hidx : idx < h.cells.length then
    let cell := h.cells.get ⟨idx, hidx⟩
    if cell.allocated then
      .ok { cells := h.cells.set ⟨idx, hidx⟩ { value := val, allocated := true } }
    else .error .UseAfterFree
  else .error .DataLengthMismatch

theorem Heap.alloc_increases_size (h : Heap) (size : Nat) (v : ℝ) :
    (h.alloc size v).1.cells.length = h.cells.length + size := by
  simp only [Heap.alloc, List.length_append, List.length_replicate]

theorem Heap.read_after_alloc (h : Heap) (size : Nat) (v : ℝ) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < size) :
    (h.alloc size v).1.read ((h.alloc size v).2 + i) = .ok v := by
  simp only [Heap.alloc, Heap.read]
  have hlen : h.cells.length + i < (h.cells ++ List.replicate size { value := v, allocated := true }).length := by
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate]
    omega
  simp only [hlen, ↓reduceDIte]
  have hget : (h.cells ++ List.replicate size { value := v, allocated := true }).get ⟨h.cells.length + i, hlen⟩ =
      { value := v, allocated := true } := by
    rw [List.get_append_right]
    · simp only [List.length_replicate, List.get_replicate]
    · omega
  simp only [hget]

theorem Heap.use_after_free_error (h : Heap) (startIdx size idx : Nat)
    (hAlloc : idx < h.cells.length)
    (hInRange : startIdx ≤ idx ∧ idx < startIdx + size) :
    (h.free startIdx size).read idx = .error .UseAfterFree := by
  simp only [Heap.free, Heap.read]
  have hlen : (h.cells.mapIdx fun i cell =>
      if startIdx ≤ i ∧ i < startIdx + size then { cell with allocated := false } else cell).length = h.cells.length := by
    simp only [List.length_mapIdx]
  simp only [hlen, hAlloc, ↓reduceDIte]
  have hget : (h.cells.mapIdx fun i cell =>
      if startIdx ≤ i ∧ i < startIdx + size then { cell with allocated := false } else cell).get ⟨idx, by rw [hlen]; exact hAlloc⟩ =
      { (h.cells.get ⟨idx, hAlloc⟩) with allocated := false } := by
    simp only [List.get_mapIdx]
    simp only [hInRange, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
  simp only [hget]

structure Shape where
  dims : List Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Shape.product (s : Shape) : Nat := s.dims.foldl (· * ·) 1

structure TensorSpec where
  shape : Shape
  data : List ℝ
  deriving DecidableEq

def isShape2D (s : Shape) : Prop := s.dims.length = 2

instance (s : Shape) : Decidable (isShape2D s) := by
  unfold isShape2D
  exact Nat.decEq _ _

def rows2D (s : Shape) (h : isShape2D s) : Nat :=
  s.dims.get ⟨0, by simp only [isShape2D] at h; omega⟩

def cols2D (s : Shape) (h : isShape2D s) : Nat :=
  s.dims.get ⟨1, by simp only [isShape2D] at h; omega⟩

def validateTensor2D (t : TensorSpec) : Checked Unit :=
  if h2 : isShape2D t.shape then
    let r := rows2D t.shape h2
    let c := cols2D t.shape h2
    if t.data.length = r * c then .ok ()
    else .error .DataLengthMismatch
  else .error .ShapeMismatch

theorem validateTensor2D_ok_is2D {t : TensorSpec}
    (h : validateTensor2D t = .ok ()) : isShape2D t.shape := by
  simp only [validateTensor2D] at h
  split at h
  case isTrue ht => exact ht
  case isFalse => simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h

theorem validateTensor2D_ok_len {t : TensorSpec}
    (h : validateTensor2D t = .ok ())
    (h2 : isShape2D t.shape) :
    t.data.length = rows2D t.shape h2 * cols2D t.shape h2 := by
  simp only [validateTensor2D] at h
  split at h
  case isTrue ht =>
    split at h
    case isTrue hlen =>
      have : h2 = ht := by apply proof_irrel
      subst this
      exact hlen
    case isFalse => simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h
  case isFalse hf => exact absurd h2 hf

def countNonFiniteReal (data : List ℝ) : Nat := 0

theorem countNonFinite_real_zero (data : List ℝ) : countNonFiniteReal data = 0 := rfl

def sanitizeSlice (data : List ℝ) : List ℝ := data

theorem sanitizeSlice_idempotent (data : List ℝ) :

def addBiasToSlice (data : List ℝ) (bias : List ℝ) (batchSize dim : Nat) :
    Checked (List ℝ) :=
  if hd : data.length < batchSize * dim then .error .DataLengthMismatch
  else if hb : bias.length < dim then .error .DataLengthMismatch
  else if hdim : dim = 0 then .ok data
  else .ok (List.ofFn fun (i : Fin data.length) =>
    data.get i + bias.get ⟨i.val % dim, by omega⟩)

theorem addBiasToSlice_ok_length {data bias : List ℝ} {bs dim : Nat} {out : List ℝ}
    (h : addBiasToSlice data bias bs dim = .ok out) :
    out.length = data.length := by
  simp only [addBiasToSlice] at h
  split at h
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h
  · split at h
    · simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h
    · split at h
      · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
        rw [← h]
      · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
        rw [← h]
        simp only [List.length_ofFn]

def mulSliceInPlace (dst src : List ℝ) : Checked (List ℝ) :=
  if dst.length ≠ src.length then .error .DataLengthMismatch
  else .ok (List.zipWith (· * ·) dst src)

theorem mulSliceInPlace_ok_length {dst src out : List ℝ}
    (h : mulSliceInPlace dst src = .ok out) :
    out.length = dst.length := by
  simp only [mulSliceInPlace] at h
  split at h
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h
  · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
    rw [← h]
    simp only [List.length_zipWith, ge_iff_le, min_eq_left_iff]
    omega

def tensorsOverlapSpec (aStart aLen bStart bLen : Nat) : Bool :=
  if aLen = 0 ∨ bLen = 0 then false
  else aStart < bStart + bLen ∧ bStart < aStart + aLen

theorem tensorsOverlap_symm (a1 al b1 bl : Nat) :
    tensorsOverlapSpec a1 al b1 bl = tensorsOverlapSpec b1 bl a1 al := by
  simp only [tensorsOverlapSpec]
  split
  case isTrue h1 =>
    split
    case isTrue h2 => rfl
    case isFalse h2 =>
      cases h1 with
      | inl hl => simp only [hl, true_or, ↓reduceIte]
      | inr hr => simp only [hr, or_true] at h2
  case isFalse h1 =>
    split
    case isTrue h2 =>
      cases h2 with
      | inl hl => simp only [hl, or_true] at h1
      | inr hr => simp only [hr, true_or] at h1
    case isFalse h2 =>
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      constructor
      · intro ⟨hab, hba⟩
        exact ⟨hba, hab⟩
      · intro ⟨hba, hab⟩
        exact ⟨hab, hba⟩

theorem tensorsOverlap_empty_left (s b1 bl : Nat) :
    tensorsOverlapSpec s 0 b1 bl = false := by
  simp only [tensorsOverlapSpec, true_or, ↓reduceIte]

theorem tensorsOverlap_empty_right (a1 al s : Nat) :
    tensorsOverlapSpec a1 al s 0 = false := by
  simp only [tensorsOverlapSpec, or_true, ↓reduceIte]

def clipVal (v lo hi : ℝ) : ℝ := max lo (min v hi)

theorem clipVal_bounds (v lo hi : ℝ) (hle : lo ≤ hi) :
    lo ≤ clipVal v lo hi ∧ clipVal v lo hi ≤ hi := by
  simp only [clipVal]
  constructor
  · exact le_max_left lo (min v hi)
  · apply max_le
    · exact hle
    · exact min_le_right v hi

theorem clipVal_idempotent (v lo hi : ℝ) (hle : lo ≤ hi) :
    clipVal (clipVal v lo hi) lo hi = clipVal v lo hi := by
  simp only [clipVal]
  have h1 : lo ≤ max lo (min v hi) := le_max_left _ _
  have h2 : max lo (min v hi) ≤ hi := max_le hle (min_le_right _ _)
  rw [min_eq_left h2, max_eq_right h1]

def clipList (data : List ℝ) (lo hi : ℝ) : List ℝ :=
  data.map (clipVal · lo hi)

theorem clipList_length (data : List ℝ) (lo hi : ℝ) :
    (clipList data lo hi).length = data.length := by
  simp only [clipList, List.length_map]

theorem clipList_bounds (data : List ℝ) (lo hi : ℝ) (hle : lo ≤ hi)
    (i : Fin (clipList data lo hi).length) :
    lo ≤ (clipList data lo hi).get i ∧ (clipList data lo hi).get i ≤ hi := by
  simp only [clipList, List.get_map]
  exact clipVal_bounds _ _ _ hle

noncomputable def expList (data : List ℝ) : List ℝ :=
  data.map Real.exp

theorem expList_length (data : List ℝ) :
    (expList data).length = data.length := by
  simp only [expList, List.length_map]

theorem expList_pos (data : List ℝ) (i : Fin (expList data).length) :
    0 < (expList data).get i := by
  simp only [expList, List.get_map]
  exact Real.exp_pos _

structure RSFLayerConfig where
  clipMin : ℝ := -5
  clipMax : ℝ := 5
  seedOffset : Nat := 0
  gradMean : Bool := true

def validLayerConfig (c : RSFLayerConfig) : Prop :=
  c.clipMin < c.clipMax ∧ c.clipMax ≤ 20 ∧ -20 ≤ c.clipMin

instance (c : RSFLayerConfig) : Decidable (validLayerConfig c) := by
  unfold validLayerConfig
  exact And.decidable

structure Mat (m n : Nat) where
  val : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ

noncomputable def matMul {m n p : Nat} (A : Mat m n) (B : Mat n p) : Mat m p :=
  ⟨fun i j => ∑ k : Fin n, A.val i k * B.val k j⟩

noncomputable def matVecMul {m n : Nat} (A : Mat m n) (v : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin m → ℝ :=
  fun i => ∑ k : Fin n, A.val i k * v k

noncomputable def matTranspose {m n : Nat} (A : Mat m n) : Mat n m :=
  ⟨fun i j => A.val j i⟩

theorem matTranspose_transpose {m n : Nat} (A : Mat m n) :
    matTranspose (matTranspose A) = A := by
  simp only [matTranspose]
  rfl

structure RSFLayerState (dim : Nat) where
  sWeight : Mat dim dim
  tWeight : Mat dim dim
  sBias : Fin dim → ℝ
  tBias : Fin dim → ℝ
  clipMin : ℝ
  clipMax : ℝ
  gradMean : Bool
  hDimPos : 0 < dim
  hClip : clipMin < clipMax

noncomputable def computeScaleVec {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ :=
  fun b d =>
    let raw := matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d
    Real.exp (clipVal raw layer.clipMin layer.clipMax)

noncomputable def computeTransVec {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ :=
  fun b d => matVecMul layer.tWeight (x1 b) d + layer.tBias d

noncomputable def couplingForward {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) × (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :=
  let scale := computeScaleVec layer x2
  let x1' := fun b d => x1 b d * scale b d
  let trans := computeTransVec layer x1'
  let x2' := fun b d => x2 b d + trans b d
  (x1', x2')

noncomputable def couplingInverse {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (y1 y2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) × (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :=
  let trans := computeTransVec layer y1
  let x2 := fun b d => y2 b d - trans b d
  let scale := computeScaleVec layer x2
  let x1 := fun b d => y1 b d / scale b d
  (x1, x2)

theorem computeScale_pos {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim) :
    0 < computeScaleVec layer x2 b d := by
  simp only [computeScaleVec]
  exact Real.exp_pos _

theorem computeScale_ne_zero {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim) :
    computeScaleVec layer x2 b d ≠ 0 :=
  ne_of_gt (computeScale_pos layer x2 b d)

theorem coupling_inverse_forward {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    couplingInverse layer (couplingForward layer x1 x2).1 (couplingForward layer x1 x2).2 = (x1, x2) := by
  simp only [couplingForward, couplingInverse]
  ext b d
  · simp only [computeScaleVec, computeTransVec]
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right]
    rw [mul_div_assoc]
    rw [div_self (ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos _))]
    ring
  · simp only [computeTransVec]
    ring

theorem coupling_forward_inverse {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (y1 y2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    couplingForward layer (couplingInverse layer y1 y2).1 (couplingInverse layer y1 y2).2 = (y1, y2) := by
  simp only [couplingForward, couplingInverse]
  ext b d
  · simp only [computeScaleVec, computeTransVec]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀]
    exact ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos _)
  · simp only [computeScaleVec, computeTransVec]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos _))]
    ring

theorem coupling_bijective {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim) :
    Function.Bijective (fun (p : (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) × (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)) =>
      couplingForward layer p.1 p.2) := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨a1, a2⟩ ⟨b1, b2⟩ h
    have := congrArg (fun p => couplingInverse layer p.1 p.2) h
    simp only [coupling_inverse_forward] at this
    exact Prod.ext this.1 this.2
  · intro ⟨y1, y2⟩
    exact ⟨(couplingInverse layer y1 y2), by simp only [coupling_forward_inverse]⟩

def multiLayerForwardAux {dim batch : Nat} :
    (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim)) →
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) →
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) × (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
  | [], x1, x2 => (x1, x2)
  | l :: ls, x1, x2 =>
    let pair := couplingForward l x1 x2
    multiLayerForwardAux ls pair.1 pair.2

def multiLayerInverseAux {dim batch : Nat} :
    (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim)) →
    (y1 y2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) →
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) × (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
  | [], y1, y2 => (y1, y2)
  | l :: ls, y1, y2 =>
    let pair := multiLayerInverseAux ls y1 y2
    couplingInverse l pair.1 pair.2

theorem multiLayer_inverse_forward {dim batch : Nat}
    (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim))
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    let fwd := multiLayerForwardAux layers x1 x2
    multiLayerInverseAux layers fwd.1 fwd.2 = (x1, x2) := by
  induction layers generalizing x1 x2 with
  | nil => simp only [multiLayerForwardAux, multiLayerInverseAux]
  | cons l ls ih =>
    simp only [multiLayerForwardAux, multiLayerInverseAux]
    rw [ih]
    exact coupling_inverse_forward l x1 x2

theorem multiLayer_forward_inverse {dim batch : Nat}
    (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim))
    (y1 y2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    let inv := multiLayerInverseAux layers y1 y2
    multiLayerForwardAux layers inv.1 inv.2 = (y1, y2) := by
  induction layers generalizing y1 y2 with
  | nil => simp only [multiLayerForwardAux, multiLayerInverseAux]
  | cons l ls ih =>
    simp only [multiLayerForwardAux, multiLayerInverseAux]
    rw [coupling_forward_inverse]
    exact ih y1 y2

def splitVec {dim batch : Nat} (x : Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ) :
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) × (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :=
  (fun b d => x b ⟨d.val, by omega⟩,
   fun b d => x b ⟨d.val + dim, by omega⟩)

def mergeVec {dim batch : Nat} (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ :=
  fun b d => if h : d.val < dim then x1 b ⟨d.val, h⟩
    else x2 b ⟨d.val - dim, by omega⟩

theorem split_merge_roundtrip {dim batch : Nat} (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    splitVec (mergeVec x1 x2) = (x1, x2) := by
  simp only [splitVec, mergeVec]
  ext b d
  · simp only [Fin.val_fin_lt, ↓reduceDIte, Fin.eta]
  · have hnd : ¬ (d.val + dim < dim) := by omega
    simp only [hnd, ↓reduceDIte]
    congr 1
    omega

theorem merge_split_roundtrip {dim batch : Nat} (x : Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ) :
    mergeVec (splitVec x).1 (splitVec x).2 = x := by
  simp only [splitVec, mergeVec]
  ext b d
  split
  case isTrue h => rfl
  case isFalse h =>
    congr 1
    omega

noncomputable def rsfForward {dim batch : Nat} (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim))
    (x : Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ) : Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ :=
  let (x1, x2) := splitVec x
  let (y1, y2) := multiLayerForwardAux layers x1 x2
  mergeVec y1 y2

noncomputable def rsfInverse {dim batch : Nat} (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim))
    (y : Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ) : Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ :=
  let (y1, y2) := splitVec y
  let (x1, x2) := multiLayerInverseAux layers y1 y2
  mergeVec x1 x2

theorem rsf_inverse_forward {dim batch : Nat} (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim))
    (x : Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ) :
    rsfInverse layers (rsfForward layers x) = x := by
  simp only [rsfForward, rsfInverse]
  rw [split_merge_roundtrip]
  simp only [multiLayer_inverse_forward]
  rw [merge_split_roundtrip]

theorem rsf_forward_inverse {dim batch : Nat} (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim))
    (y : Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ) :
    rsfForward layers (rsfInverse layers y) = y := by
  simp only [rsfForward, rsfInverse]
  rw [split_merge_roundtrip]
  simp only [multiLayer_forward_inverse]
  rw [merge_split_roundtrip]

theorem rsf_bijective {dim batch : Nat} (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim)) :
    Function.Bijective (rsfForward layers : (Fin batch → Fin (2 * dim) → ℝ) → _) := by
  constructor
  · intro a b h
    rw [← rsf_inverse_forward layers a, ← rsf_inverse_forward layers b, h]
  · intro y
    exact ⟨rsfInverse layers y, rsf_forward_inverse layers y⟩

noncomputable def logDetJacobian {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) : ℝ :=
  ∑ d : Fin dim,
    clipVal (matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d) layer.clipMin layer.clipMax

theorem logDetJacobian_eq_sum_log_scale {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) :
    logDetJacobian layer x2 b =
    ∑ d : Fin dim, Real.log (computeScaleVec layer x2 b d) := by
  simp only [logDetJacobian, computeScaleVec, Real.log_exp]

noncomputable def couplingJacobianDet {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) : ℝ :=
  ∏ d : Fin dim, computeScaleVec layer x2 b d

theorem couplingJacobianDet_pos {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) :
    0 < couplingJacobianDet layer x2 b := by
  simp only [couplingJacobianDet]
  exact Finset.prod_pos (fun d _ => computeScale_pos layer x2 b d)

structure GradState (dim : Nat) where
  sWeightGrad : Mat dim dim
  tWeightGrad : Mat dim dim
  sBiasGrad : Fin dim → ℝ
  tBiasGrad : Fin dim → ℝ

def zeroGrad (dim : Nat) : GradState dim :=
  { sWeightGrad := ⟨fun _ _ => 0⟩
  , tWeightGrad := ⟨fun _ _ => 0⟩
  , sBiasGrad := fun _ => 0
  , tBiasGrad := fun _ => 0 }

theorem zeroGrad_all_zero (dim : Nat) :
    let g := zeroGrad dim
    (∀ i j, g.sWeightGrad.val i j = 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, g.tWeightGrad.val i j = 0) ∧
    (∀ i, g.sBiasGrad i = 0) ∧
    (∀ i, g.tBiasGrad i = 0) := by
  exact ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩

noncomputable def dScaleDsPre {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim) : ℝ :=
  let raw := matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d
  if raw < layer.clipMin ∨ raw > layer.clipMax then 0
  else Real.exp raw

theorem dScaleDsPre_eq_scale_in_range {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim)
    (hIn : layer.clipMin ≤ matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d ∧
           matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d ≤ layer.clipMax) :
    dScaleDsPre layer x2 b d = computeScaleVec layer x2 b d := by
  simp only [dScaleDsPre, computeScaleVec, clipVal]
  have hNotLt : ¬ (matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d < layer.clipMin) := by linarith
  have hNotGt : ¬ (matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d > layer.clipMax) := by linarith
  simp only [hNotLt, hNotGt, or_self, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [max_eq_right hIn.1, min_eq_left hIn.2]

noncomputable def backwardGradT {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (y1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (gradScale : ℝ) : Mat dim dim :=
  ⟨fun i j => gradScale * ∑ b : Fin batch, dy2 b j * y1 b i⟩

noncomputable def backwardGradTBias {dim batch : Nat}
    (dy2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (gradScale : ℝ) : Fin dim → ℝ :=
  fun d => gradScale * ∑ b : Fin batch, dy2 b d

noncomputable def backwardGradS {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (gradScale : ℝ) : Mat dim dim :=
  ⟨fun i j => gradScale * ∑ b : Fin batch,
    dy1 b i * x1 b i * (dScaleDsPre layer x2 b i) * x2 b j⟩

noncomputable def backwardGradSBias {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (gradScale : ℝ) : Fin dim → ℝ :=
  fun d => gradScale * ∑ b : Fin batch,
    dy1 b d * x1 b d * (dScaleDsPre layer x2 b d)

noncomputable def backwardDx1 {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ :=
  fun b d => dy1 b d * computeScaleVec layer x2 b d

theorem backward_dx1_spec {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim) :
    backwardDx1 layer dy1 x2 b d = dy1 b d * computeScaleVec layer x2 b d := rfl

noncomputable def backwardFullLayer {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (y1 y2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (dy1 dy2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) ×
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) ×
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) ×
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :=
  let trans := computeTransVec layer y1
  let x2 := fun b d => y2 b d - trans b d
  let scale := computeScaleVec layer x2
  let x1 := fun b d => y1 b d / scale b d
  let dy1_adj := fun b d => dy1 b d +
    ∑ k : Fin dim, layer.tWeight.val k d * dy2 b k
  let dx1 := fun b d => dy1_adj b d * scale b d
  let dx2 := fun b d => dy2 b d +
    ∑ k : Fin dim, layer.sWeight.val k d *
      (dy1_adj b k * x1 b k * dScaleDsPre layer x2 b k)
  (dx1, dx2, x1, x2)

theorem backward_recovers_input {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (dy1 dy2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    let fwd := couplingForward layer x1 x2
    let bwd := backwardFullLayer layer fwd.1 fwd.2 dy1 dy2
    (∀ b d, bwd.2.2.1 b d = x1 b d) ∧
    (∀ b d, bwd.2.2.2 b d = x2 b d) := by
  simp only [couplingForward, backwardFullLayer, computeScaleVec, computeTransVec]
  constructor
  · intro b d
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right]
    rw [mul_div_assoc, div_self (ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos _))]
    ring
  · intro b d
    ring

def gradScaleSpec (gradMean : Bool) (batchSize : Nat) : ℝ :=
  if gradMean then
    if batchSize = 0 then 1 else 1 / (batchSize : ℝ)
  else 1

theorem gradScale_pos (gm : Bool) (bs : Nat) (hbs : 0 < bs) :
    0 < gradScaleSpec gm bs := by
  simp only [gradScaleSpec]
  split
  · split
    · omega
    · apply div_pos one_pos
      exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr hbs
  · exact one_pos

theorem gradScale_le_one (gm : Bool) (bs : Nat) (hbs : 0 < bs) :
    gradScaleSpec gm bs ≤ 1 := by
  simp only [gradScaleSpec]
  split
  · split
    · omega
    · apply div_le_one_of_le
      · exact le_of_lt (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hbs)
      · exact Nat.cast_nonneg bs
  · le_refl

noncomputable def accumulateGrad {m n : Nat} (existing : Mat m n) (update : Mat m n) (scale : ℝ) : Mat m n :=
  ⟨fun i j => existing.val i j + scale * update.val i j⟩

theorem accumulateGrad_zero_start {m n : Nat} (update : Mat m n) (scale : ℝ) :
    accumulateGrad ⟨fun _ _ => 0⟩ update scale = ⟨fun i j => scale * update.val i j⟩ := by
  simp only [accumulateGrad, zero_add]

theorem accumulateGrad_linear {m n : Nat} (g : Mat m n) (u1 u2 : Mat m n) (s : ℝ) :
    accumulateGrad (accumulateGrad g u1 s) u2 s =
    ⟨fun i j => g.val i j + s * u1.val i j + s * u2.val i j⟩ := by
  simp only [accumulateGrad]
  ext i j
  ring

def splitIntoSpec (dim : Nat) (data : List ℝ) (batchSize : Nat) :
    Checked (List ℝ × List ℝ) :=
  if hlen : data.length ≠ batchSize * (2 * dim) then .error .DataLengthMismatch
  else if hdim : dim = 0 then .ok ([], [])
  else if hbs : batchSize = 0 then .ok ([], [])
  else
    let x1 := List.ofFn fun (i : Fin (batchSize * dim)) =>
      data.get ⟨(i.val / dim) * (2 * dim) + (i.val % dim), by
        push_neg at hlen
        have hi := i.isLt
        have hdiv : i.val / dim < batchSize := Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul (by omega)
        have hmod : i.val % dim < dim := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
        omega⟩
    let x2 := List.ofFn fun (i : Fin (batchSize * dim)) =>
      data.get ⟨(i.val / dim) * (2 * dim) + dim + (i.val % dim), by
        push_neg at hlen
        have hi := i.isLt
        have hdiv : i.val / dim < batchSize := Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul (by omega)
        have hmod : i.val % dim < dim := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
        omega⟩
    .ok (x1, x2)

theorem splitInto_lengths {dim : Nat} {data : List ℝ} {bs : Nat}
    {x1 x2 : List ℝ} (h : splitIntoSpec dim data bs = .ok (x1, x2))
    (hdim : dim > 0) (hbs : bs > 0) :
    x1.length = bs * dim ∧ x2.length = bs * dim := by
  simp only [splitIntoSpec] at h
  split at h
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h
  · split at h
    · omega
    · split at h
      · omega
      · simp only [Except.ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        constructor <;> (rw [← h.1] <|> rw [← h.2]) <;> simp only [List.length_ofFn]

def mergeFromSpec (dim : Nat) (x1 x2 : List ℝ) (batchSize : Nat) :
    Checked (List ℝ) :=
  if x1.length ≠ batchSize * dim ∨ x2.length ≠ batchSize * dim then
    .error .DataLengthMismatch
  else if hdim : dim = 0 then .ok []
  else if hbs : batchSize = 0 then .ok []
  else
    .ok (List.ofFn fun (i : Fin (batchSize * (2 * dim))) =>
      let b := i.val / (2 * dim)
      let d := i.val % (2 * dim)
      if hd : d < dim then x1.get ⟨b * dim + d, by
        push_neg at hdim hbs
        have hi := i.isLt
        have hb : b < batchSize := by
          apply Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
          calc i.val < batchSize * (2 * dim) := hi
            _ = (2 * dim) * batchSize := by ring
        omega⟩
      else x2.get ⟨b * dim + (d - dim), by
        push_neg at hdim hbs
        have hi := i.isLt
        have hb : b < batchSize := by
          apply Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
          calc i.val < batchSize * (2 * dim) := hi
            _ = (2 * dim) * batchSize := by ring
        have hdd : d - dim < dim := by
          have hd2 : d < 2 * dim := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
          omega
        omega⟩)

theorem mergeFrom_length {dim : Nat} {x1 x2 : List ℝ} {bs : Nat} {out : List ℝ}
    (h : mergeFromSpec dim x1 x2 bs = .ok out) :
    out.length = bs * (2 * dim) := by
  simp only [mergeFromSpec] at h
  split at h
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h
  · split at h
    · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
      rw [← h]
      simp only [List.length_nil]
      omega
    · split at h
      · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
        rw [← h]
        simp only [List.length_nil]
        omega
      · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
        rw [← h]
        simp only [List.length_ofFn]

def computeScale_bounded_spec {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim)
    (hMin : -20 ≤ layer.clipMin) (hMax : layer.clipMax ≤ 20) :
    Real.exp (-20) ≤ computeScaleVec layer x2 b d ∧
    computeScaleVec layer x2 b d ≤ Real.exp 20 := by
  simp only [computeScaleVec]
  have hclip := clipVal_bounds (matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d)
    layer.clipMin layer.clipMax (le_of_lt layer.hClip)
  constructor
  · apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    linarith
  · apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    linarith

theorem scale_division_safe {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim) :

theorem xavierBound_pos (dim : Nat) (hd : 0 < dim) :

def serializeLayerSpec {dim : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim) : SerializedLayer :=
  { sW := List.ofFn fun (ij : Fin (dim * dim)) =>
      layer.sWeight.val ⟨ij.val / dim, by
        have := ij.isLt
        apply Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
        calc ij.val < dim * dim := this
          _ = dim * dim := rfl⟩ ⟨ij.val % dim, Nat.mod_lt _ layer.hDimPos⟩
  , tW := List.ofFn fun (ij : Fin (dim * dim)) =>
      layer.tWeight.val ⟨ij.val / dim, by
        have := ij.isLt
        apply Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
        calc ij.val < dim * dim := this
          _ = dim * dim := rfl⟩ ⟨ij.val % dim, Nat.mod_lt _ layer.hDimPos⟩
  , sB := List.ofFn fun (i : Fin dim) => layer.sBias i
  , tB := List.ofFn fun (i : Fin dim) => layer.tBias i
  , clipMin := layer.clipMin
  , clipMax := layer.clipMax
  , gradMean := layer.gradMean }

theorem serializeLayer_valid {dim : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)

theorem multiLayer_bijective {dim batch : Nat} (layers : List (RSFLayerState dim)) :
    Function.Bijective (fun (p : (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) × (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)) =>

noncomputable def couplingJacobianDet {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) : ℝ :=
  ∏ d : Fin dim, computeScaleVec layer x2 b d

theorem couplingJacobianDet_pos {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) :
    0 < couplingJacobianDet layer x2 b := by
  simp only [couplingJacobianDet]
  exact Finset.prod_pos (fun d _ => computeScale_pos layer x2 b d)

structure GradState (dim : Nat) where
  sWeightGrad : Mat dim dim
  tWeightGrad : Mat dim dim
  sBiasGrad : Fin dim → ℝ
  tBiasGrad : Fin dim → ℝ

def zeroGrad (dim : Nat) : GradState dim :=
  { sWeightGrad := ⟨fun _ _ => 0⟩
  , tWeightGrad := ⟨fun _ _ => 0⟩
  , sBiasGrad := fun _ => 0
  , tBiasGrad := fun _ => 0 }

theorem zeroGrad_all_zero (dim : Nat) :
    let g := zeroGrad dim
    (∀ i j, g.sWeightGrad.val i j = 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, g.tWeightGrad.val i j = 0) ∧
    (∀ i, g.sBiasGrad i = 0) ∧
    (∀ i, g.tBiasGrad i = 0) := by
  exact ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩

noncomputable def dScaleDsPre {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim) : ℝ :=
  let raw := matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d
  if raw < layer.clipMin ∨ raw > layer.clipMax then 0
  else Real.exp raw

theorem dScaleDsPre_eq_scale_in_range {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim)
    (hIn : layer.clipMin ≤ matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d ∧
           matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d ≤ layer.clipMax) :
    dScaleDsPre layer x2 b d = computeScaleVec layer x2 b d := by
  simp only [dScaleDsPre, computeScaleVec, clipVal]
  have hNotLt : ¬ (matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d < layer.clipMin) := by linarith
  have hNotGt : ¬ (matVecMul layer.sWeight (x2 b) d + layer.sBias d > layer.clipMax) := by linarith
  simp only [hNotLt, hNotGt, or_self, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [max_eq_right hIn.1, min_eq_left hIn.2]

noncomputable def backwardGradT {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (y1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (gradScale : ℝ) : Mat dim dim :=
  ⟨fun i j => gradScale * ∑ b : Fin batch, dy2 b j * y1 b i⟩

noncomputable def backwardGradTBias {dim batch : Nat}
    (dy2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (gradScale : ℝ) : Fin dim → ℝ :=
  fun d => gradScale * ∑ b : Fin batch, dy2 b d

noncomputable def backwardGradS {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (gradScale : ℝ) : Mat dim dim :=
  ⟨fun i j => gradScale * ∑ b : Fin batch,
    dy1 b i * x1 b i * (dScaleDsPre layer x2 b i) * x2 b j⟩

noncomputable def backwardGradSBias {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (gradScale : ℝ) : Fin dim → ℝ :=
  fun d => gradScale * ∑ b : Fin batch,
    dy1 b d * x1 b d * (dScaleDsPre layer x2 b d)

noncomputable def backwardDx1 {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ :=
  fun b d => dy1 b d * computeScaleVec layer x2 b d

theorem backward_dx1_spec {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (dy1 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) (b : Fin batch) (d : Fin dim) :
    backwardDx1 layer dy1 x2 b d = dy1 b d * computeScaleVec layer x2 b d := rfl

noncomputable def backwardFullLayer {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (y1 y2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (dy1 dy2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) ×
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) ×
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) ×
    (Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :=
  let trans := computeTransVec layer y1
  let x2 := fun b d => y2 b d - trans b d
  let scale := computeScaleVec layer x2
  let x1 := fun b d => y1 b d / scale b d
  let dy1_adj := fun b d => dy1 b d +
    ∑ k : Fin dim, layer.tWeight.val k d * dy2 b k
  let dx1 := fun b d => dy1_adj b d * scale b d
  let dx2 := fun b d => dy2 b d +
    ∑ k : Fin dim, layer.sWeight.val k d *
      (dy1_adj b k * x1 b k * dScaleDsPre layer x2 b k)
  (dx1, dx2, x1, x2)

theorem backward_recovers_input {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)
    (x1 x2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ)
    (dy1 dy2 : Fin batch → Fin dim → ℝ) :
    let fwd := couplingForward layer x1 x2
    let bwd := backwardFullLayer layer fwd.1 fwd.2 dy1 dy2
    (∀ b d, bwd.2.2.1 b d = x1 b d) ∧
    (∀ b d, bwd.2.2.2 b d = x2 b d) := by
  simp only [couplingForward, backwardFullLayer, computeScaleVec, computeTransVec]
  constructor
  · intro b d
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right]
    rw [mul_div_assoc, div_self (ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos _))]
    ring
  · intro b d
    ring

def gradScaleSpec (gradMean : Bool) (batchSize : Nat) : ℝ :=
  if gradMean then
    if batchSize = 0 then 1 else 1 / (batchSize : ℝ)
  else 1

theorem gradScale_pos (gm : Bool) (bs : Nat) (hbs : 0 < bs) :
    0 < gradScaleSpec gm bs := by
  simp only [gradScaleSpec]
  split
  · split
    · omega
    · apply div_pos one_pos
      exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr hbs
  · exact one_pos

theorem gradScale_le_one (gm : Bool) (bs : Nat) (hbs : 0 < bs) :
    gradScaleSpec gm bs ≤ 1 := by
  simp only [gradScaleSpec]
  split
  · split
    · omega
    · apply div_le_one_of_le
      · exact le_of_lt (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hbs)
      · exact Nat.cast_nonneg bs
  · le_refl

noncomputable def accumulateGrad {m n : Nat} (existing : Mat m n) (update : Mat m n) (scale : ℝ) : Mat m n :=
  ⟨fun i j => existing.val i j + scale * update.val i j⟩

theorem accumulateGrad_zero_start {m n : Nat} (update : Mat m n) (scale : ℝ) :
    accumulateGrad ⟨fun _ _ => 0⟩ update scale = ⟨fun i j => scale * update.val i j⟩ := by
  simp only [accumulateGrad, zero_add]

theorem accumulateGrad_linear {m n : Nat} (g : Mat m n) (u1 u2 : Mat m n) (s : ℝ) :
    accumulateGrad (accumulateGrad g u1 s) u2 s =
    ⟨fun i j => g.val i j + s * u1.val i j + s * u2.val i j⟩ := by
  simp only [accumulateGrad]
  ext i j
  ring

def splitIntoSpec (dim : Nat) (data : List ℝ) (batchSize : Nat) :
    Checked (List ℝ × List ℝ) :=
  if hlen : data.length ≠ batchSize * (2 * dim) then .error .DataLengthMismatch
  else if hdim : dim = 0 then .ok ([], [])
  else if hbs : batchSize = 0 then .ok ([], [])
  else
    let x1 := List.ofFn fun (i : Fin (batchSize * dim)) =>
      data.get ⟨(i.val / dim) * (2 * dim) + (i.val % dim), by
        push_neg at hlen
        have hi := i.isLt
        have hdiv : i.val / dim < batchSize := Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul (by omega)
        have hmod : i.val % dim < dim := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
        omega⟩
    let x2 := List.ofFn fun (i : Fin (batchSize * dim)) =>
      data.get ⟨(i.val / dim) * (2 * dim) + dim + (i.val % dim), by
        push_neg at hlen
        have hi := i.isLt
        have hdiv : i.val / dim < batchSize := Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul (by omega)
        have hmod : i.val % dim < dim := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
        omega⟩
    .ok (x1, x2)

theorem splitInto_lengths {dim : Nat} {data : List ℝ} {bs : Nat}
    {x1 x2 : List ℝ} (h : splitIntoSpec dim data bs = .ok (x1, x2))
    (hdim : dim > 0) (hbs : bs > 0) :
    x1.length = bs * dim ∧ x2.length = bs * dim := by
  simp only [splitIntoSpec] at h
  split at h
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h
  · split at h
    · omega
    · split at h
      · omega
      · simp only [Except.ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        constructor <;> (rw [← h.1] <|> rw [← h.2]) <;> simp only [List.length_ofFn]

def mergeFromSpec (dim : Nat) (x1 x2 : List ℝ) (batchSize : Nat) :
    Checked (List ℝ) :=
  if x1.length ≠ batchSize * dim ∨ x2.length ≠ batchSize * dim then
    .error .DataLengthMismatch
  else if hdim : dim = 0 then .ok []
  else if hbs : batchSize = 0 then .ok []
  else
    .ok (List.ofFn fun (i : Fin (batchSize * (2 * dim))) =>
      let b := i.val / (2 * dim)
      let d := i.val % (2 * dim)
      if hd : d < dim then x1.get ⟨b * dim + d, by
        push_neg at hdim hbs
        have hi := i.isLt
        have hb : b < batchSize := by
          apply Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
          calc i.val < batchSize * (2 * dim) := hi
            _ = (2 * dim) * batchSize := by ring
        omega⟩
      else x2.get ⟨b * dim + (d - dim), by
        push_neg at hdim hbs
        have hi := i.isLt
        have hb : b < batchSize := by
          apply Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
          calc i.val < batchSize * (2 * dim) := hi
            _ = (2 * dim) * batchSize := by ring
        have hdd : d - dim < dim := by
          have hd2 : d < 2 * dim := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
          omega
        omega⟩)

theorem mergeFrom_length {dim : Nat} {x1 x2 : List ℝ} {bs : Nat} {out : List ℝ}
    (h : mergeFromSpec dim x1 x2 bs = .ok out) :
    out.length = bs * (2 * dim) := by
  simp only [mergeFromSpec] at h
  split at h
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq] at h
  · split at h
    · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
      rw [← h]
      simp only [List.length_nil]
      omega
    · split at h
      · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
        rw [← h]
        simp only [List.length_nil]
        omega
      · simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at h
        rw [← h]
        simp only [List.length_ofFn]

def computeScale_bounded_spec {dim batch : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim)

    linarith

def serializeLayerSpec {dim : Nat} (layer : RSFLayerState dim) : SerializedLayer :=
  { sW := List.ofFn fun (ij : Fin (dim * dim)) =>

        have := ij.isLt
        apply Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
        calc ij.val < dim * dim := this

  , tW := List.ofFn fun (ij : Fin (dim * dim)) =>
      layer.tWeight.val ⟨ij.val / dim, by

        apply Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
        calc ij.val < dim * dim := this
          _ = dim * dim := rfl⟩ ⟨ij.val % dim, Nat.mod_lt _ layer.hDimPos⟩
  , sB := List.ofFn fun (i : Fin dim) => layer.sBias i

  , clipMin := layer.clipMin

A konkrét architektúra **affine coupling layereket** alkalmaz, ahol a bemeneti vektort két részre osztják (`x1`, `x2`), majd az egyik rész egy skálázó- és eltolástranszformáción esik át a másik függvényében.[2]
